due_when.clears_when: the batch collector skips records already on origin/main at landing time, with a test; or the manager kills this because batches can no longer overlap (e.g. concurrency-serialised)

origin.rerun: git fetch origin main; for each research/results/*.jsonl in an open automation/research-results-batch-* PR, git cat-file -e origin/main:<path>  (any hit means the batch is stale)

what: research-results batch landing can race: PR #14644 (dispatcher run 36683756944, 08:21Z) was assembled from a view where 6 records (RQ-20260928-025..029, RQ-20260930-501) were not yet on main, but an earlier batch (#14598, run 36680457944) had already landed them. Result: add/add conflicts on 6 research/results/*.jsonl (differ only in generated_at), mergeable_state dirty, 0 check runs, 536,555 additions in 83 files, open 11h until closed as superseded by lane RESEARCH-W7 (verified 83 of 83 files on main, 77 byte-identical). Fix direction: make the collector's 'not yet on main' check read origin/main at landing time (skip a record whose path already exists there) rather than at collection time.
